# MANTIX

> Nepal's next streetwear identity — designed T-shirts. Smart fashion, sharp identity.

MANTIX is a Nepal-based streetwear label launching with a first limited drop of three precision-crafted designed T-shirts. Minimal, bold, youth-focused fashion for Nepal's new generation — built around the idea that what you wear is part of your identity.

## Brand
- Name: MANTIX
- Tagline: Smart Fashion. Sharp Identity.
- Based in: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Launch: First limited drop, 2026
- Starting price: Rs. 1,399

## First Collection (limited drop)
- The Phantom (Black Oversized) — Rs. 1,499. Premium everyday streetwear essential. Oversized fit.
- The Ghost (White Essential) — Rs. 1,399. Clean minimal design for daily wear. Regular / oversized fit.
- The Venom (Dark Green Signature) — Rs. 1,499. Core MANTIX identity colorway. Oversized fit.
